youtube.title: The Lost Dog Posters Had One Strange Detail
youtube.description:
Nine lost-dog posters, nine different owners, one phone number. Here is how the scam worked, seen from the inside.

A teenager dials the number on a street full of posters, and a stranger thanks her for calling about "the dog" before she has named one. In three minutes you will see how a free-poster offer, a printer and one phone line can turn worried owners into a payment, and the single question the caller could not answer. If you searched for how the scam worked, or for a short animated con artist story, start here.
